description: Guided opt-out fer ZoomInfo, which lists folk by email address. One opt-out covers every saved email address.
instructions: Open https://privacy.zoominfo.com/, look up {full_name} with yer employer, choose the listing an' ask fer it to be removed. Verify with each work email ZoomInfo asks about. Yer saved addresses: {all_emails}. Then smash "I've done this".
